pressureSignals.quote: If you don't pay today, your subscription will be suspended.
pressureSignals.explanation: A negative consequence is threatened if payment is not made promptly.

pressureSignals.quote: Keep this confidential until the migration is complete.
pressureSignals.explanation: The caller asks the user to keep the request secret.

pressureSignals.quote: Use the new account details I texted you, not the saved payment method.
pressureSignals.explanation: The caller instructs the user to bypass the saved payment method and use a new account.

raw.summary: The caller claims to be Kettle and Co. billing, representing Kettle and Co., and requests a $18.00 USD payment to Kettle & Co. (billing@kettleandco.example) for a monthly coffee subscription renewal, urging immediate payment, threatening suspension, requesting secrecy, and directing use of new account details instead of the saved method.
